testPolicy.text: Columbia College and Columbia Engineering remain test optional for the 2026-2027 admissions cycle (fall 2027 entry). Starting August 2027 (2027-2028 cycle, fall 2028 entry) first-year and transfer applicants must submit the ACT or SAT; applicants facing challenges may request a waiver without disadvantage.
testPolicy.since: test optional since 2020; required again from the 2027-28 cycle

gpa.doc: CDS 2025-26, C12 (footnote: 99.9% had a GPA on any scale; the 4.25 average and C11 distribution are based on the 72.2% with GPAs recorded on a 4.0 scale)

cost.totalIncludes: First-year on-campus budget: tuition 72,800 + fees 4,160 (includes one-time transcript and orientation fees of 730) + food 7,128 + housing 12,522 + books and supplies 1,320 + personal 1,844. Travel varies and is listed separately (two round trips, e.g. 944 from Indiana, 1,254 from California). Continuing on-campus students: total 100,884 (fees 3,430, food 7,586, housing 13,904).

aidPromise.text: Families with calculated incomes below $66,000 and typical assets pay $0 parent contribution; families below $150,000 and typical assets (assets up to about $250,000) attend tuition-free. Aid meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants and work only, no loans. Admission is need-blind for US citizens, eligible noncitizens and undocumented students residing in the US; international applicants are not need-blind, but those admitted with funding have full need met.

facts.text: Early Decision is a big lever: for fall 2025, 819 of 5,868 Early Decision applicants were admitted (14.0%), against 2,127 of the other 53,743 applicants (4.0%).
Families with incomes below $150,000 and typical assets attend tuition-free, and below $66,000 the parent contribution is $0.
The 2026-27 first-year on-campus budget is $99,774 before travel; first-year students are required to live on campus.
International applicants faced a tighter door for fall 2025: 407 of 15,380 were admitted (2.6%), against 447 of 8,882 New York residents (5.0%) and 2,092 of 35,349 other US applicants (5.9%).
Columbia stays test optional for fall 2027 entrants but will require the SAT or ACT from August 2027 for the 2027-28 cycle.
Columbia School of General Studies (for nontraditional students) publishes its own separate Common Data Set; the figures here cover Columbia College and Columbia Engineering only.

notes: opir.columbia.edu is behind a Cloudflare check for HTML pages; the CDS page link list was read in Chrome, the PDF itself downloads with curl. Contradiction: CDS 2025-26 C8A marks SAT or ACT as required 'for Fall 2027', but the admissions testing page says test optional for the 2026-2027 cycle and required from August 2027 (fall 2028 entry). The admissions office page is used. Required fees in CDS G1: 4,160 first-year, 3,430 undergraduates; CDS G1 food and housing first-year 19,650 matches the aid office. ED rate split computed from CDS C21 counts. No Early Action. Columbia did not have a published official Class of 2030 profile that I could open (class profile URLs redirect to the general FAQ). The 'no loans' wording: 'Loans are not used to meet financial need or included in initial financial aid awards' (How Aid Works page).
